Editing profi"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"le patches by hand is error-prone, and two classes of problems bite people often:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **Gateway incompatibility** — not every vendor accepts the same protocol dialect. Max-thinking configs and per-model "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"`reasoningEfforts` are tedious to author by hand."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin gives you a GUI for all of it, plus **one-click presets** that bake in dialect-safe conf"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"igurations (see Presets)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Per-model editor** for every route:
- `name`, `contextWindow`, `maxTokens` — capacity fields acc"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ept plain numbers or `K`/`M` suffixes (`262144`, `256K`, `1M`).
- Supports both explicit `models` li"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"sts and DSH 0.1.7 catalog-preserving `modelOverrides` entries.
- `input` modalities — `text` / `imag"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"e` checkboxes with de-duplication.
- Thinking toggle — switch the whole model between reasoning off "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"and the full 7-level matrix (`off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max`), each level with its own wire "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"value. Empty non-`off` levels are prevented (the Host rejects them), and a one-click **fill all leve"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ls with the same value** button is included.
- **Apply field to all models** of the route (name / co"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ntextWindow / maxTokens / input / reasoningEfforts).
- Per-model `compat` editor (folded away by def"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ault).
- **Per-route editor**:
- `displayName`, `baseURL`, `api` (openai-completions / openai-respon"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"ses / anthropic-messages).
- Defaults: `defaultContextWindow`, `defaultMaxTokens`, `defaultInput`, `"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"reasoning`, `thinkingBudgets` (minimal/low/medium/high), `cacheRetention`, `transport`.
- Route-leve"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"l `compat` editor, including DSH 0.1.7 finish-reason, thinking-budget, `max_output_tokens`, Baseten "},{"id":"p10s13","text":"and vLLM controls, plus an **Advanced** fold for timeouts, image limits, `headers`, and raw JSON.
- "},{"id":"p10s14","text":"**Controlled models.dev synchronization**:
- Reads the cache or fetches `api.json` only when you cli"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"ck **Load catalog**; **Fetch latest catalog** explicitly refreshes it. Each local route can be mappe"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"d to a models.dev provider or excluded.
- Shows a dry-run count before writing. Only existing models"},{"id":"p10s17","text":" whose IDs match (case-insensitively) are updated; no route or model is added or removed.
- `name`, "},{"id":"p10s18","text":"context limit, output limit, and supported `text`/`image` inputs are independently selectable. Reaso"},{"id":"p10s19","text":"ning is opt-in because provider wire semantics vary: explicit effort lists are mapped, `reasoning: f"},{"id":"p10s20","text":"alse` disables reasoning, and toggle-only/unknown formats preserve the manual value.
